The most recent round appears to be a **$75M Series B led by Smash Capital**, announced September 22 (2026, per the timeline in these results). Other participants reportedly included Altos, Nexus Venture Partners, Y Combinator, Freestyle, and Offline Ventures. Firecrawl announced the Series B and launched Alexandria, a service giving AI agents access to specialized datasets through one interface.

Sources disagree on the lead's name. One calls it Smash Ventures, while others say Smash Capital. The results don't settle which is correct.

A separate SEC Form D filing reports a larger amount. Firecrawl sold $82,063,463 of preferred stock to seven investors, according to a Form D filed with the SEC on September 14th. That filing doesn't name investors or give a valuation. Reporting also notes that the announced Series B is about $7.1 million below the gross amount reported to the SEC, and neither disclosure explains the difference.

The earlier round was a **$14.5M Series A led by Nexus Venture Partners**, announced in August 2025. Investors included Y Combinator, Shopify CEO Tobias Lütke, Zapier, and Postman's CEO.
